test_title: PYST 56: SSC GD Constable - Quantitative Aptitude (Held on: 13th November 2021 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: A salesman sells an item at a profit of 21%. If he had bought it at 12% less and sold it for Rs. 66 less, he would have gained 30%. Find the cost price of the item.
solution:
Formula :

SP = CP × (1 + Gover100) 

Where, G = Gain%

Calculation:

Let, the original CP be 100 unit

original SP after 21% profit =100 × (100 +21)/100 = 121 unit

New CP = 100 × (100 -12)/100 = 88 unit

New SP after 30% gain = 88 × 130/100 = 114.4 unit

So, Difference in SP = (121 - 114.4) = 6.6 unit

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/af5b925aaf5c7349c7f154fc098f99075bcf0deb06cc8653cb17f019266cf668.png] 

According to the question,

⇒ 6.6 unit = Rs. 66

⇒ 1 unit = Rs. 10

So, original CP = 100 × 10 = Rs. 1000

∴ The cost price is Rs 1000.
